info.title: BetterContact API
info.description: The official BetterContact API to find new leads and enrich them with verified work emails and mobile phone numbers.

post.description:
Submit between 1 and 100 leads for waterfall email and phone enrichment.

This endpoint is asynchronous: it answers immediately with a `id` (the `request_id`) and enriches in the background. Retrieve the results with [`GET /async/{request_id}`](/api-reference/endpoint/get), or provide a `webhook` to have them pushed to you.

201.description: Enrichment request accepted. Poll `GET /async/{request_id}` or wait for the webhook.

400.description: Bad request. The `data` attribute is missing or is not an array, or the batch exceeds 100 leads.

401.description: Unauthorized. The API key is missing, invalid or deactivated.

402.description: Payment required. Either the account has no credits left, or the requested feature (`enrich_phone_number`, `verify_catch_all`) is not enabled on the current plan. Read `message` to tell them apart.

500.description: Unexpected server error. Safe to retry.

post.description:
Find new leads from company and people criteria.

This endpoint is asynchronous: it answers immediately with a `request_id` and searches in the background. Retrieve the results with [`GET /lead_finder/async/{request_id}`](/api-reference/endpoint/lead_finder_get), or provide a `webhook` to have them pushed to you.

Several filters only accept exact values from a fixed list. See [Taxonomies](/api-reference/taxonomies).

requestBody.description: Filters and parameters for lead finding

202.description: Lead Finder request accepted. Poll `GET /lead_finder/async/{request_id}` or wait for the webhook.

400.description: Bad request. The `filters` object is missing, or every filter is empty.

example.error: Filters parameter is invalid. Include and Exclude can not be blank

401.description: Unauthorized. The API key is missing, invalid or deactivated.

402.description: Payment required. The account has no credits left.

example.error: You do not have enough tokens to use Lead Finder API.

422.description: Unprocessable. The free Lead Finder search quota is exhausted, the request could not be created, or the search is a single company lookup that belongs on [Enrich a company profile](/api-reference/enrich_profile/company).

example.message: You are out of free lead finder requests. Please upgrade your plan to continue using this feature.

500.description: Unexpected server error. Safe to retry.

get.description:
Returns the credit balance of the account the API key belongs to.

Authentication uses the `X-API-Key` header like every other endpoint. The `api_key` query parameter is a legacy alternative kept for backward compatibility; the `email` query parameter is ignored and the email is always resolved from the key.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Legacy alternative to the `X-API-Key` header. Prefer the header.

credits_left.description: Credits remaining on the account, across the whole organisation.

email.description: Email of the account the API key belongs to.

401.description: Unauthorized. The API key is missing, invalid or deactivated.

get.description:
Retrieve the results of an enrichment request.

Answers `202` with no `data` while the request is still running, and `200` with `status: "terminated"` once it is done. Branch on `status`, never on the HTTP code alone. See [Request statuses](/api-reference/statuses).

200.description: Request finished. `status` is `terminated` and `data` holds the enriched leads.

202.description: Request accepted but not finished yet. `data` and `summary` are absent. Poll again later.

example.message: Enrichment is not terminated yet. Please try later

401.description: Unauthorized. The API key is missing, invalid or deactivated.

406.description: Unknown `request_id`, or the request does not belong to this account.

500.description: Unexpected server error. Safe to retry.

get.description:
Retrieve the results of a Lead Finder search.

Answers `202` with no `leads` while the search is still running, and `200` with `status: "terminated"` once it is done. Branch on `status`, never on the HTTP code alone. See [Request statuses](/api-reference/statuses).

200.description: Search finished. `status` is `terminated` (`leads` present, possibly empty) or `on_hold` (top up credits to resume).

202.description: Request accepted but not finished yet. `leads` and `summary` are absent. Poll again later.

example.message: Lead finder request is not terminated yet. Please try later

401.description: Unauthorized. The API key is missing, invalid or deactivated.

404.description: Unknown `request_id`, or the request does not belong to this account.

post.description:
Look up a single company by domain, LinkedIn URL, or both. Unlike the other endpoints this one is **synchronous**: the profile comes back in the same response, there is no `request_id` to poll.

**This endpoint does not consume credits.**

Authentication accepts either the `X-API-Key` header like every other endpoint, or an `api_key` attribute in the request body.

keyInBody.summary: With the key in the body

401.description: Unauthorized. The API key is missing, invalid or deactivated.

404.description: No company matched the identifier you sent.

500.description: Unexpected error on our side, or an upstream failure. Safe to retry.

post.description:
Look up a single person and get their profile plus their current company. This endpoint is **synchronous**: the profile comes back in the same response, there is no `request_id` to poll.

**Cost: 0.1 credit per profile found.** Nothing is charged when no profile matches.

It returns profile data only. It does **not** return an email address or a phone number: for that, use [Enrich leads](/api-reference/endpoint/create).

Authentication accepts either the `X-API-Key` header like every other endpoint, or an `api_key` attribute in the request body.

401.description: Unauthorized. The API key is missing, invalid or deactivated.

402.description: Not enough credits to run the lookup.

example.error: You do not have enough credits to perform a profile search.

404.description: No profile matched. Nothing is charged.

422.description: Neither `linkedin_url` nor the `first_name` + `last_name` + `company_domain` combination was provided.

example.error: Linkedin url OR First_name, last_name, company and company domain is missing

data.description: Leads to enrich. Between 1 and 100 per call. Sending more than 100 is rejected with `400`.

company.description: Company name. Provide either `company` or `company_domain`. `company_domain` gives better results.

linkedin_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL. Strongly recommended when `enrich_phone_number` is `true`, and required for `enrich_profile`.

custom_fields.description:
Any data you want echoed back in the response, such as a CRM record id. Keys are free-form; `uuid` and `list_name` below are only an example.

Sent as an object, returned as an array of `{ name, value, position }` entries.

enrich_email_address.description: Enrich the work email address. When `enrich_email_address`, `enrich_phone_number` and `enrich_profile` are all omitted or `false`, email enrichment is applied by default.

enrich_phone_number.description: Enrich the mobile phone number. Requires the phone add-on on your plan, otherwise the call is rejected with `402`. Provide `linkedin_url` for best results.

enrich_profile.description: Enrich the full LinkedIn profile of the contact (headline, seniority, location, current company). Requires `linkedin_url`.

verify_catch_all.description: Run the extra catch-all verification layer. When enabled, `contact_email_address_status` returns `catch_all_safe` / `catch_all_not_safe` instead of `catch_all`. Requires the catch-all add-on on your plan, otherwise the call is rejected with `402`.

webhook.description: URL that receives the full result payload as soon as the whole batch is done. Recommended over polling. See [Webhooks](/api-reference/webhooks).

push_contact_individually.description: When `true`, each lead is pushed to `contact_webhook` as soon as it is enriched, instead of waiting for the whole batch. Useful for batches of 100.

contact_webhook.description: URL that receives one payload per lead. Only used when `push_contact_individually` is `true`.

process_flow.description: Identifier of the process flow to use for this enrichment. Only for accounts subscribed to the process flow add-on.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time the waterfall is allowed to run before the request is terminated with whatever has been found. Defaults to the timeout configured on your account.

limit.description: Number of leads to return for this request, between 1 and 200. Use it together with `offset` to paginate. Mutually exclusive with `max_leads`: when `limit` is set, `max_leads` is ignored.

offset.description:
Zero-based number of leads to skip before returning matches. Only taken into account when `limit` is set.

To walk through results, keep `limit` constant and increase `offset` by `limit` on each call: `0`, then `100`, then `200`, and so on. The total number of matching leads is returned as `summary.leads_found`.

max_leads.description: Number of leads to return when you do not paginate. Between 1 and 200, defaults to 100. Ignored when `limit` is set.

webhook.description: URL that receives the results as soon as the search is done, removing the need to poll. See [Webhooks](/api-reference/webhooks).

enrich_email_address.description: When `true`, every lead found is also run through the waterfall email enrichment before the results are returned. This consumes enrichment credits on top of the search, and the request stays in `processing` until enrichment is done.

enrich_phone_number.description: When `true`, every lead found is also run through the waterfall mobile phone enrichment before the results are returned. This consumes enrichment credits on top of the search. Requires the phone add-on on your plan.

LeadFinderFilters.description: At least one filter value must be provided, otherwise the request is rejected with `400`.

company_headcount_min.description: Minimum employee count. Converted server-side into the overlapping company size ranges listed in [Taxonomies - Company size ranges](/api-reference/taxonomies#company-size-ranges).

company_headcount_max.description: Maximum employee count. Converted server-side into the overlapping company size ranges listed in [Taxonomies - Company size ranges](/api-reference/taxonomies#company-size-ranges).

last_funding_date_range.description: Date of the last funding round, as `YYYY-MM-DD` strings.

last_amount_raised_usd.description: Amount raised in the last round, in USD.

total_amount_raised_usd.description: Total amount raised to date, in USD.

is_b2b.description: Restrict to companies selling to businesses. `false` is a meaningful value and is sent as-is.

is_b2c.description: Restrict to companies selling to consumers. `false` is a meaningful value and is sent as-is.

job_post_titles.description: Job titles the company is currently hiring for.

job_posting_countries.description: Countries the company is currently hiring in.

job_posting_locations.description: Cities or regions the company is currently hiring in.

limit_per_company.description: Caps how many leads are returned per company. Useful to spread results across accounts instead of returning a whole org chart. Maximum 100.

FilterObject.description: `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

exact_match.description: When `true`, only job titles strictly equal to an `include` value are returned. When `false` (default), titles containing the value also match.

JobTitleFilter.description: Job title filter. This is the only filter whose `exclude` is applied natively by the provider.

include.description: Seniority levels that must match. Must be exact values from the predefined list, see [Taxonomies - Seniority levels](/api-reference/taxonomies#seniority-levels).

exclude.description: Seniority levels that must NOT match.

SeniorityFilter.description: `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

exclude.description: Company domains that must NOT match.

CompanyDomainFilter.description: Filter on the contact's current company domain. `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

include.description: Company industries that must match. Must be exact values from the predefined list, see [Taxonomies - Industries](/api-reference/taxonomies#industries).

exclude.description: Company industries that must NOT match. Same accepted values as `include`.

CompanyIndustryFilter.description: `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

include.description: Lead departments that must match. Must be exact values from the predefined list, see [Taxonomies - Departments](/api-reference/taxonomies#departments).

exclude.description: Lead departments that must NOT match.

LeadDepartmentFilter.description: `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

include.description: Lead functions that must match. Uses the same accepted values and the same underlying field as `lead_department`, see [Taxonomies - Functions](/api-reference/taxonomies#functions).

exclude.description: Lead functions that must NOT match.

LeadFunctionFilter.description: `lead_function` and `lead_department` resolve to the same provider field. Setting both widens the match rather than narrowing it. `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

status.description: See [Request statuses](/api-reference/statuses). Only `terminated` guarantees `data` and `summary` are present.

message.description: Human readable hint. Only present while the request is not terminated.
message.example: Enrichment is not terminated yet. Please try later

credits_consumed.description: Credits spent by this request so far.

total.description: Number of leads in the request.

catch_all.description: Emails on a catch-all domain. Reported as `catch_all_safe` instead when catch-all verification is enabled.

catch_all_not_safe.description: Catch-all emails judged unsafe to send to. Only when catch-all verification is enabled.

not_found.description: Leads for which no email was found.

found.description: Phone numbers found. Only present when `enrich_phone_number` was requested.

status.description: See [Request statuses](/api-reference/statuses). A search that matched nothing is reported as `terminated` with an empty `leads` array.

message.description: Human readable hint. Only present while the search is not terminated.
message.example: Lead finder request is not terminated yet. Please try later

credits_consumed.description: Credits spent by this search. Zero unless `enrich_email_address` or `enrich_phone_number` was requested.

leads_found.description: Total number of leads matching the filters, regardless of `limit`. Use it to size your pagination. Absent when enrichment was requested.

limit.description: The `limit` used for this page. Only present when paginating.

offset.description: The `offset` used for this page. Only present when paginating.

total.description: Number of leads enriched. Only present when enrichment was requested.

valid.description: Emails verified as `deliverable`. Only present when `enrich_email_address` was requested.

catch_all.description: Emails on a catch-all domain. Only present when `enrich_email_address` was requested.

catch_all_not_safe.description: Catch-all emails judged unsafe to send to.

not_found.description: Leads for which no email was found.

found.description: Phone numbers found. Only present when `enrich_phone_number` was requested.

leads.description: Only present once `status` is `terminated`. Empty array when nothing matched.

LeadObject.description:
One lead returned by the search. Every key below is always present, with `null` when the value is unknown.

For backward compatibility the response also carries a set of legacy keys that are always `null` (`company_logo`, `company_size`, `contact_avatar`, `company_website`, `company_address_*`, `contact_experience`, `contact_connections`, and others). Ignore them.

contact_id.description: BetterContact internal identifier for this contact.

contact_headline.description: LinkedIn headline. Named `contact_linkedin_headline` in the enrichment response.

contact_email_address.description: Work email address. Only filled when `enrich_email_address` was requested.

contact_email_address_status.description: Verification verdict. Only filled when `enrich_email_address` was requested.

contact_email_address_provider.description: Waterfall vendor that found the email. Vendors under NDA are reported as `Secret Provider`.

contact_phone_number.description: Mobile phone number in E.164 format. Only filled when `enrich_phone_number` was requested.

company_linkedin_url.description: Company LinkedIn page URL. Not provided by the current data source, so it is `null` on most leads.

company_employees_range_start.description: Lower bound of the headcount range.

company_employees_range_end.description: Upper bound of the headcount range.

company_head_quarters_city.description: Headquarters city. Note the spelling: the enrichment response uses `company_headquarters_city`.

company_head_quarters_country.description: Headquarters country. Note the spelling: the enrichment response uses `company_headquarters_country`.

position.description: Index of the field in the object you sent.

custom_fields.description: Empty for Lead Finder results. Only enrichment requests echo custom fields back.

success.description: Not returned by the enrichment endpoints.

error.example: Your are not authorized. Please check your api_key.

include.description: HQ locations that must match. Accepts country names (e.g. "United States"), and also states or cities.

exclude.description: HQ locations that must NOT match. Same format as `include`.

CompanyHqLocationFilter.description: `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

include.description: Technologies that must match. Must be exact values from the predefined list, see [Taxonomies - Technologies](/api-reference/taxonomies#technologies).

exclude.description: Technologies that must NOT match. Same accepted values as `include`.

CompanyTechnologiesFilter.description: `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

ApiError.description: Generic error envelope. Depending on the endpoint the human readable text is carried by `error` or by `message`, so always read both.

EnrichedContact.description:
One enriched lead. Every key below is always present, with `null` when the value could not be found.

For backward compatibility the response also carries a set of legacy keys that are always `null` (`company_logo`, `company_size`, `contact_avatar`, `company_website`, `contact_experience`, `company_address_*`, `contact_additional_phone_number`, and others). Ignore them.

enriched.description: `true` when the lead was successfully enriched and is not on an opt-out list. Check this before using the row.

contact_id.description: BetterContact internal identifier for this contact.

position.description: Index of the field in the object you sent.

custom_fields.description:
Your custom fields, echoed back.

**The shape differs from the request**: you send an object, you get back an array of `{ name, value, position }` entries, one per key. Look the field up by `name`, do not index by position.

contact_location_state.description: State or region of the contact.

contact_email_address.description: Work email address. `null` when `enrich_email_address` was not requested or nothing was found.

contact_email_address_status.description: Verification verdict. `deliverable`, `catch_all` and `catch_all_safe` are safe to send to. `catch_all_not_safe` and `undeliverable` are not. `catch_all_safe` / `catch_all_not_safe` only appear when catch-all verification is enabled on the account.

contact_email_address_provider.description: Waterfall vendor that found the email address. Vendors under NDA are reported as `Secret Provider`.

email_provider.description: Mailbox host of the email address, not a BetterContact vendor. Do not confuse it with `contact_email_address_provider`.

contact_phone_number.description: Mobile phone number in E.164 format. `null` when `enrich_phone_number` was not requested or nothing was found.

contact_phone_number_provider.description: Waterfall vendor that found the phone number. Vendors under NDA are reported as `Secret Provider`.

company_employees_range_start.description: Lower bound of the headcount range.

company_employees_range_end.description: Upper bound of the headcount range.

include.description: Company LinkedIn page URLs that must match. Normalised server-side, so both the full URL and the slug are accepted.

exclude.description: Company LinkedIn page URLs that must NOT match.

CompanyLinkedinUrlFilter.description: `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

include.description: Free-text keywords searched across the company profile.

CompanyKeywordsFilter.description: Free text, no taxonomy. `company_keywords` and `company_description` are searched against the same underlying field, so combining both widens the match rather than narrowing it. `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

include.description: Free-text phrases searched in the company description.

exclude.description: Phrases that must NOT appear in the company description.

CompanyDescriptionFilter.description: Searched against the same underlying field as `company_keywords`. `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

include.description: Revenue brackets that must match. Must be exact values from the predefined list, see [Taxonomies - Revenue ranges](/api-reference/taxonomies#revenue-ranges).

exclude.description: Revenue brackets that must NOT match.

RevenueRangesFilter.description: `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

include.description: Last funding round names that must match. Must be exact values from the predefined list, see [Taxonomies - Funding round names](/api-reference/taxonomies#funding-round-names).

exclude.description: Last funding round names that must NOT match.

FundingRoundNamesFilter.description: `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

include.description: Values that must match on the company's active job postings.

exclude.description: Values that must NOT match on the company's active job postings.

JobPostingFilter.description: Signals based on the company's currently open roles. `exclude` is applied by BetterContact after the provider call, so a request made only of `exclude` values matches nothing. Always pair it with at least one `include`.

EnrichCompanyRequest.description: At least one of `company_domain` or `company_linkedin_url` is required. You can send both.

api_key.description: Your API key. Only needed if you do not send the `X-API-Key` header.

CompanyProfile.description: The company profile. Fields below carry data; every other `company_*` key from the Lead Finder payload is still present and always `null`, kept for payload compatibility. Landbase-only attributes such as `revenue`, `is_b2b` and `technologies_used` are not returned here.

company_description.example: Bodegas Aragonesas S.A. is a winery...

company_type.description: Company type, lowercased with spaces replaced by underscores. `Privately Held` becomes `privately_held`.

company_employees_range_start.description: Lower bound of the headcount range, parsed from the size range. `11-50` gives `11`.

company_employees_range_end.description: Upper bound of the headcount range. `null` on open ended ranges: `10000+` sets the start only.

company_headquarters.example: Carr. de Magallón a la Almunia, S/N; Fuendejalón, Aragón / España 50529, ES

company_head_quarters_city.description: Headquarters city. May be an empty string when the source has no city.

company_address_city.description: City part of the headquarters address.

company_address_state.description: State or region part of the headquarters address.

company_address_country.description: Country part of the headquarters address.

company_address_zipcode.description: Postal code part of the headquarters address.

EnrichLeadRequest.description:
Identify the lead in one of two ways:

- **By LinkedIn URL**: send `linkedin_url` alone. This is the most reliable form.
- **By name and company**: send `first_name`, `last_name` and `company_domain`.

`linkedin_url` takes precedence: when it is present the other attributes are ignored.

linkedin_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL of the contact. Sufficient on its own.

first_name.description: First name. Required when you do not send `linkedin_url`.

last_name.description: Last name. Required when you do not send `linkedin_url`.

company_domain.description: Company domain. Required when you do not send `linkedin_url`.

company.description: Company name. Complements `company_domain`, it cannot replace it.

api_key.description: Your API key. Only needed if you do not send the `X-API-Key` header.

LeadProfile.description: The lead profile. These are all the keys returned: unlike the enrichment and Lead Finder payloads there are no extra always-null legacy keys.

contact_linkedin_headline.description: LinkedIn headline. Often an empty string rather than null.

company_employees_range_start.description: Lower bound of the headcount range.

company_employees_range_end.description: Upper bound of the headcount range. `null` on open ended ranges such as `10001+`.

company_headquarters_city.description: Headquarters city. Can carry a full street address rather than a bare city name.
